title: Pacific Southwest Airlines 182
summary: PSA Flight 182, a Boeing 727, collided mid-air with a Cessna 172 during approach to San Diego on a clear day with 10 miles visibility. The PSA crew lost visual contact with the Cessna despite ATC instructions to maintain visual separation and did not report the loss of sight. The NTSB determined the probable cause was the PSA flight crew's failure to follow proper air traffic control procedures.
probable_cause: The probable cause of the accident was the failure of the PSA flight crew to follow proper air traffic control procedures. Flight 182's crew lost sight of the Cessna in contravention of ATC instructions to keep visual separation from that traffic and did not alert ATC that they had lost sight of it. Errors on the part of ATC were also named as contributing factors, including the use of visual separation procedures when radar clearances were available.

factors.evidence: the PSA crew lost sight of the Cessna in contravention of ATC instructions to keep visual separation from that traffic
did not alert ATC that they had lost sight of it
the use of visual separation procedures when radar clearances were available
both the Boeing and the Cessna crashed into North Park
the crash destroyed or damaged 22 homes

events.text: The PSA crew was alerted by the approach controller about a small Cessna 172 aircraft nearby.
The crew lost sight of the Cessna in contravention of ATC instructions to maintain visual separation.
Both aircraft collided mid-air over San Diego after the Cessna was no longer visible to the PSA crew.
Both aircraft crashed in a residential but urban uptown neighborhood roughly three miles northeast of downtown San Diego, killing all aboard both aircraft and seven people on the ground.

title: Icelandic Airlines 001
summary: Loftleiðir Flight 001 crashed on approach to Colombo on November 15, 1978. The crew was cleared to descend on runway 22 for an ILS approach. The approach controller warned the flight was undershooting but the crew was speaking with the radar controller on another frequency and did not receive the advisory. The aircraft descended dangerously towards the ground and crashed into a rubber and coconut plantation. The crash killed 183 out of 262 passengers and crew.
probable_cause: The official report determined the probable cause to be the failure of the crew to conform to approach procedures. During the approach, the crew did not properly monitor descent rate and position.

factors.evidence: The crew was speaking with the radar controller on another frequency and did not receive the warning that they were undershooting.
The aircraft was descending dangerously towards the ground and crashed into a rubber and coconut plantation.
Thunderstorms were in the area and wind shear was an issue.
The DC-8 crashed into a rubber and coconut plantation and exploded.
